hooks.name: Guard .kiro is tracked
hooks.description: Blocks file writes whenever .kiro has become gitignored, protecting the hard submission requirement that .kiro stays tracked.

action.command: if git check-ignore -v .kiro >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ".kiro is gitignored — Hackachusetts requirement #2 violated. Remove any .kiro entry from .gitignore." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
